dashboard.description: Portal traffic, scanner activity, honeypot hits and login flood detection

search.query: index=cybersteps_web sourcetype="nginx:access" earliest=-7d | rex "\"\s+(?<status>\d{3})\s" | stats count by status | sort -count

index=cybersteps_web sourcetype="nginx:access" earliest=-7d | rex "^(?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | rex "\"(?<method>[A-Z]+)\s(?<url>\S+)" | rex "\"\s+(?<status>\d{3})\s" | search status=403 | stats count by url, src_ip | sort -count

panel.title: Login Endpoint POST Volume Over Time (7d)

index=cybersteps_web sourcetype="nginx:access" earliest=-7d | rex "\d{3}\s+\d+\s+\"[^\"]*\"\s+\"(?<useragent>[^\"]+)\"" | stats count by useragent | sort -count | head 10
